# reco_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists all API keys for the tenant. Does not include secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_api_keys" "all" {}

output "api_key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.reco_api_keys.all.api_keys : k.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) List of API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Email of the creator.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `permitted_ips` (List of String) IP allowlist.
- `role` (String) Assigned role name.
- `state` (String) Key state.
